CustomField.description: Each Opportunity must contain a number identifying what # SOW this would be within the year for the client if this Opportunity was set to Closed/Won. For example, if a client already has 2 SOWs for the year, the number for the new opportunity would be 3.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: SOW Number of the Original Opportunity that this Change Order is based on.
CustomField.label: SOW Number
